rationale: layout-baseline-renewal: the dispatch-only regeneration of the layout-guard baseline as an artifact. One run is one firing of layout-baseline-renewal.yml. Registered so the workflow records its own run (CLAUDE.md rule 17) and the closure gate's NEVER-RUN check reads the ledger row; the artifact is emitted by scripts/lib/emit-workflow-run-artifact.mjs from the workflow's own record job.
